testUncertainty.limitation: Reflects this weak-label sample and source groups; does not account for label error or deployment shift.

ranking.conclusion: The learned ranker recalled 94.9% of black-trumpet-labeled test photos, versus 57.6% for color and texture. Precision was 77.7%, below the 80% validation target. It ranks photos or candidate crops for review; it does not establish discovery range or species identity.
limitations: Targets are weak observation labels, not independent species or image-content confirmation.
Photo/crop classification does not discover or locate mushrooms in woodland scenes.
Black-trumpet-vs-other-fungi scores are uncalibrated, not probabilities of correct identification or edibility.
Official preprocessing uses a central crop; off-center fungi may be omitted.
Observer, observation, photo and content hashes are disjoint across splits; perceptual duplicates may remain.
Empirical validation precision targets do not guarantee future precision.
No physical detection range, depth accuracy, obstacle avoidance or automatic flight gate is validated.

discovery.notes: 12 selected photos / 30 approximate boxes, frozen before predictions; overlap threshold 0.5. All photos contain fungi. Compare tiling only within the same four context photos. More detections can bring more false boxes; generic detection remains the default. No physical range has been measured.

scaleStress.note: Recall on four repeated scenes shrunk within a fixed canvas. Blur, JPEG and padding are artificial; these are not measured distances. At ⅛ scale, all eight targets smaller than 16 pixels were missed.

habitat.notes: Actual scene segmentation on 12 archive photos proposed nine unlocated inspection leads; three close-up controls were withheld. Ecological accuracy is unmeasured. The optional SegFormer model is licensed for research/evaluation only and is excluded from deployment packages.
